source: PixelLab character 978bfe24 (south-east rotation, robe stretched 7 rows) animated with animate_image_pixminimax; frames snapped to the 8-colour palette, specks < 12 px removed, pieces lifted so feet sit on the bottom row. cast_gesture (9 frames, the Knight's timings) = cast f2, f4, f6, f7, victory f5 (hand pulled back = the coil, frame 4 = the cast pack's gesture_hold_frame), victory f6 x2 (palm out = the slash, frame 5), victory f5, cast f8. See design/assets/specs/mage-assets.md. draw and the dash clips (step_forward / step_back / step_down) are recentred on the head (x 47) because the game glides the unit; step_up was rejected (turns to a back view), the up step plays `step`. idle replaced 2026-11-05 by anim03/idle_v3 (PixMiniMax, first and last frame pinned to the anchor, positive breathing prompt; raw f0-f7, f8 = f0 dropped).

clips.name: step_forward
clips.note: 2026-11-16 v7 dash, weaponless bodies (user 'Bam dat' / 'chot gen lai cho cac char con lai'). animate_image_pixminimax from the APPROVED weaponless anchor as BOTH first_frame_url and last_frame_url - pinning the last frame is what makes the clip return to the standing pose (the 2026-11-16 first attempt, pinned only at the start, flew off horizontally and never landed). Wording is swordsman-assets.md ASSET-001-DASH verbatim: knees bend, hips drop, chest tips at a SHALLOW angle (not 'far forward', which reads as a headfirst dive), hands trail BEHIND the hips with elbows pointing backward, holds ONE leaning shape unchanged for four frames - a dash has no stride - then plants, rises and finishes upright. No speed words. Every part stays inside the frame. step_up additionally states the SILHOUETTE WIDTH ('stays at least as wide as the first frame'), the clause that finally stopped the up clip turning into a back view on all four characters. Source frames 1,2,3,4,5,7,8 (anticipation, four held, brake, upright). Cleaned mechanically only: snapped to the unit's master-palette colours with tools/qa/sprite_clean.gd.
